skill.summary: Ganesh Image Hosting API for image hosting. Use when user mentions "Ganesh", "upload image", "image hosting", or asks about image sharing.

latestVersion.changelog:
Ganesh Image Hosting API skill initial release.

- Introduces Ganesh, a free image hosting service.
- Supports uploading images and generating shareable URLs.
- Can be used for image sharing, embedding, or documentation.
- Allows anonymous uploads without requiring an account.
- Links to official API documentation for up-to-date usage details.
